metaTitle: Executive coaching for top leaders — a one-to-one programme
metaDescription: A coaching programme for CEOs, directors and heads of companies: 7 sessions. Delegation, a successor, the team, stepping out of day-to-day operations. Gani Abadan — a trainer since 2012 who has personally trained over 10,000 people.
title: You built a company. Who will build you?
lead: Coaching for top leaders — 7 sessions that change your management style, your team and your results.

traps.q: I check everything myself, because no one will do it as well
traps.d: Fear of delegating. Behind it is a specific bad experience: someone let you down or deceived you. A defensive reaction that chokes growth.

traps.q: I can't take a holiday — everything stops without me
traps.d: There is no successor. You are the bottleneck. You can't grow further because there is no one to hand your current role to.

traps.q: I get angry at mistakes and criticise instead of giving feedback
traps.d: The team is afraid to tell the truth. You make decisions on incomplete information. Results suffer.

traps.q: There is no one to talk to honestly
traps.d: Your reports tell you what you want to hear. Your family doesn't know the context. Peers are competitors. You stew in your own thoughts.

trapsNote: It isn't a character flaw — it's a defensive reaction. But it chokes both you and your team.
results: You see the root of the problem, not the symptoms

faq.q: How is coaching different from training?
faq.a: Training gives a group knowledge and skills. Coaching is one-to-one work on your specific request. A coach doesn't teach — they help you find your own solutions through the right questions, structure and an outside view.

faq.q: I don't have time for 7 weeks
faq.a: One session is 60–90 minutes a week. Less than a meeting. Time frees up through better delegation.

faq.q: How do I know it's right for me?
faq.a: Start with a free 15-minute call. We'll go through your request and tell you honestly whether coaching will help in your situation. No obligation.
Yes. Sessions run online, and in-person meetings are possible in Almaty. What matters is your request and readiness to work.
The cost is agreed individually and depends on the format and scope of work. Get in touch and we'll find an option.

faq.q: What if it isn't right after the first session?
faq.a: You decide whether to continue after the first session — no obligation. The first session is a diagnosis that is valuable in itself.
